title: {{name}} · Network Performance
scope: This server-side test analyzes the ProxyHub server egress and the node's Xray tunnel. It does not measure the network path from an end-user device to this server.
capabilityUnavailable: Network performance targets are not configured on the Agent.
emptyBody: Run a standard test to compare the server's direct baseline with the Xray tunnel.

analysisCode.TARGET_PATH_DEGRADED: One target is markedly slower than the others. This can indicate a target path or CDN routing difference.
analysisCode.SERVER_EGRESS_OR_TARGET_PATH_SLOW: The direct baseline is currently slow while tunnel efficiency remains normal.
analysisCode.TUNNEL_PERFORMANCE_DEGRADED: Tunnel throughput is substantially below the direct server baseline across targets.
analysisCode.TUNNEL_EFFICIENCY_HEALTHY: Tunnel efficiency is healthy relative to the direct baseline.
analysisCode.ALL_TARGETS_FAILED: All configured targets failed. Check server egress, the tunnel, and target availability.

error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_TEST_BUSY: Another performance test is already running.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_NODE_NOT_FOUND: The selected node no longer exists.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_NODE_DISABLED: Enable the node before running a performance test.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_UNSUPPORTED_NODE: This version supports VLESS TCP REALITY Vision nodes.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_TARGET_INVALID: The Agent Target Registry is missing or invalid.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_TARGET_UNREACHABLE: The target could not be reached.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_TUNNEL_FAILED: The temporary Xray tunnel could not complete the request.
error.NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_CLEANUP_FAILED: Temporary test resources could not be cleaned safely.

partialNote: Some targets failed; successful target data is still shown.
failedNote: The test did not produce a successful target result.
clientReminder: For end-user experience, also test from the actual client network.
